programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E1
programme.desc: Riko, a teenager from Muara Enim, is cursed to remain celibate until he’s 30. Life is smooth until he moves to Jakarta on a scholarship, where endless temptations drive him to despair. With his friend Frans, Riko seeks answers and a way to break free.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E1
programme.desc: Riko, seorang remaja asal Muara Enim, dikutuk untuk tetap selibat hingga usia 30 tahun. Hidupnya berjalan lancar sampai ia pindah ke Jakarta dengan beasiswa, di mana berbagai godaan tanpa henti membuatnya putus asa. Bersama temannya, Frans, Riko mencari jawaban dan cara untuk membebaskan diri.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E2
programme.desc: On his first day of school, Riko nearly dies but finds an unlikely friend in Frans, who helps him explore his illness—and introduces him to the world of pornography. Meanwhile, Sabrina dives into dating apps, and Desi faces her boss's advances at her new job.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E2
programme.desc: Pada hari pertamanya di sekolah, Riko hampir saja meninggal, tetapi ia menemukan teman yang tak terduga dalam diri Frans, yang membantunya memahami penyakitnya—dan memperkenalkannya pada dunia pornografi. Sementara itu, Sabrina mulai terjun ke aplikasi kencan, dan Desi menghadapi godaan dari atasannya di tempat kerja barunya.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E3
programme.desc: Riko shines in the first half of his futsal game, but things spiral when he’s distracted by cheerleaders in revealing outfits, leading to him puking on Ilham. Realizing he’s not better, he and Frans seek help. Meanwhile, Sabrina’s dating app matches fail, sparking interest in Mahesa, a barista at her favorite café.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E3
programme.desc: Riko tampil gemilang di babak pertama pertandingan futsalnya, tetapi keadaan menjadi kacau ketika ia terdistraksi oleh para pemandu sorak dengan pakaian terbuka, hingga akhirnya ia muntah mengenai Ilham. Menyadari bahwa kondisinya belum membaik, ia dan Frans pun mencari bantuan. Sementara itu, perjodohan Sabrina di aplikasi kencan terus gagal, sehingga ia mulai tertarik pada Mahesa, seorang barista di kafe favoritnya.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E4
programme.desc: After struggling to be honest in the sharing house, Riko turns to a psychologist. He loves the sessions but faces financial hurdles. Meanwhile, Desi wrestles with Bram’s offer to be his second wife, and Sabrina grows closer to Mahesa, ignoring warnings about his underage girlfriend.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E4
programme.desc: Setelah kesulitan untuk bersikap jujur di rumah berbagi, Riko akhirnya mendatangi seorang psikolog. Ia menyukai sesi-sesi tersebut, tetapi menghadapi kendala keuangan. Sementara itu, Desi bergulat dengan tawaran Bram untuk menjadi istri keduanya, dan Sabrina semakin dekat dengan Mahesa, mengabaikan peringatan tentang pacarnya yang masih di bawah umur.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E5
programme.desc: After Sabrina rejects Riko, Frans sets him up with other women, but none work out. A scam lands Riko washing dishes at a café, where he bonds with Adel. Together, they spark Sabrina's jealousy as she faces Mahesa’s manipulative love bombing. Meanwhile, Desi meets Bram’s wife and gains her blessing to become his second wife, while Frans finally dates Flo.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E5
programme.desc: Setelah Sabrina menolak Riko, Frans menjodohkannya dengan beberapa perempuan lain, tetapi tidak ada yang berhasil. Sebuah penipuan membuat Riko berakhir mencuci piring di sebuah kafe, di mana ia kemudian akrab dengan Adel. Bersama-sama, mereka memicu kecemburuan Sabrina saat ia menghadapi sikap manipulatif Mahesa yang melakukan love bombing. Sementara itu, Desi bertemu dengan istri Bram dan mendapatkan restunya untuk menjadi istri keduanya, sedangkan Frans akhirnya mulai berkencan dengan Flo.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E6
programme.desc: Riko and Frans drift apart after a big fight. Frans focuses on his new romance with Flo, while Sabrina and the Lust Gang investigate a leaked deepfake video. Riko, sidelined after facing harassment, seeks advice from Sabrina, leading to unexpected confrontations at home.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E6
programme.desc: Riko dan Frans mulai menjauh setelah pertengkaran besar. Frans fokus pada hubungan barunya dengan Flo, sementara Sabrina dan Lust Gang menyelidiki video deepfake yang bocor. Riko, yang tersisih setelah mengalami pelecehan, mencari nasihat dari Sabrina, yang kemudian memicu konfrontasi tak terduga di rumah.

Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Ketawa Dimana Aja S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketawa Di mana Aja (Laughter Wherever You Are) is an entertainment program that is presented in the form of a virtual stand up comedy. A host of well-known comedians join the show, among others are Ananta Rispo, Boah Sartika, Indra Frimawan, Indra Jegel, and many more.

programme.title: Ketawa Dimana Aja S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketawa Di Mana Aja (Laughter Wherever You Are) adalah sebuah program hiburan yang disajikan dalam format stand up comedy virtual. Acara ini menghadirkan sejumlah komika ternama sebagai pengisi acara, di antaranya Ananta Rispo, Boah Sartika, Indra Frimawan, Indra Jegel, dan masih banyak lagi.

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, who recently broke up with Jessica, feels there is no point in working hard as a magazine photographer. In the midst of his mental turmoil, Razi meets Jane who offers Razi a side job as a paparazzi. Eventually he accepted the offer, although at first he wanted to withdraw because the risk was too dangerous. Razi then traveled to Yogyakarta with Jane. Formerly, he wanted to help Jane meet a witch to do something on Jane's father's mistress. But the two of them unexpectedly experience an exciting and tense adventure being held hostage by the heretical sect of the Kamilia Divine Kingdom in Gunung Kidul. As a result of being together in the suffering situation, the seeds of love between Razi and Jane start to grow.

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E1

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Daur Hidup S1 E4

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.desc: Agen India Khalid menjalankan misi untuk memburu dan mengeliminasi mantan mentornya, agen teratas negara tersebut, Kabir, yang telah membelot. Perang mematikan pun dimulai.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: After her mother’s death, Jhanak is forced to marry her cousin Arshi’s fiancé, Aniruddh, to escape her stalker, Tejas. Although Aniruddh and Arshi have been together for seven years, Jhanak enters their lives under distressing circumstances and begins working as a maid in the Bose household. While some family members treat her kindly, others constantly insult and belittle her.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha mengisahkan kehidupan kelas menengah Sachin dan Sailee saat mereka menghadapi kompleksitas hubungan mereka. Cerita ini berpusat pada perjuangan Sailee saat ia menghadapi hambatan berupa suami yang menolak dan upayanya untuk menginspirasi perubahan, bukan hanya untuk pertumbuhan mereka sendiri, tetapi juga untuk kesejahteraan seluruh keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: Reet, seorang jurnalis cerdas, dan Raghav yang temperamental, menikah melalui perjodohan berdasarkan adat ‘Aata Sata’ demi menjamin kebahagiaan saudara-saudara mereka. Hubungan mereka yang didasari kepentingan ini menghadapi lika-liku yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Satria Bergitar
programme.desc: In the kingdom of Antioch Gaza, King Wasit Aron (WD Mochtar) is gathering his forces to reclaim his throne, which was seized by Abu Garin (Soultan Saladin). The greedy Abu Garin will not rest until he has married Wasit’s daughter, Tirza (Ricca Rachim), and seized the magical gem known as the Pearl of the Ocean of Challenges, which is still in Wasit’s possession.

programme.title: Satria Bergitar
programme.desc: Di negeri Antioch Gaza, Raja Wasit Aron (WD Mochtar) menyusun kekuatan untuk merebut kembali tahtanya yang dirampas Abu Garin (Soultan Saladin). Abu Garin yang serakah ini belum juga puas jika belum berhasil mengawini putri Wasit bernama Tirza (Ricca Rachim) dan mengambil batu mustika bernama Mutiara Samudera Tantangan yang masih dikuasai Wasit.

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Tells the story of a married couple named Daniel and Anya who just moved to Bandung. Once, Daniel accidentally brought home a doll from the project site where he worked. Anya was happy to keep it at home. But a neighbor named Niken was surprised to see the doll

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sepasang suami istri bernama Daniel dan Anya yang baru pindah rumah ke Bandung. Suatu ketika, Daniel tanpa sengaja membawa pulang boneka dari lokasi proyek tempat ia bekerja. Anya pun dengan senang hati menyimpannya di rumah. Tapi seorang tetangganya yang bernama Niken terkejut melihat boneka itu

programme.title: Membakar Matahari
programme.desc: Yanti married by Rachman and receives martial arts lesson from his grandfather to take revenge on the robbers and the pimp who trapped her in prostitution.

programme.title: Membakar Matahari
programme.desc: Setelah menikah dengan Rachman, Yanti mendapat pelajaran bela diri dari kakek suaminya. Hal ini ia lakukan demi membalas dendam kepada para perampok dan mucikari yang telah menjerumuskannya ke dalam dunia prostitusi.

programme.title: China O'Brien

programme.title: China O'Brien

programme.title: A Birder's Guide To Everything
programme.desc: David Portnoy, a fifteen-year-old birding fanatic, thinks that he's made the discovery of a lifetime. So, on the eve of his father's remarriage, he escapes on an epic road trip with his best friends to solidify their place in birding history.

programme.title: A Birder's Guide To Everything
programme.desc: David Portnoy, seorang penggemar burung berusia lima belas tahun, mengira bahwa ia telah membuat penemuan terbesar dalam hidupnya. Jadi, pada malam sebelum pernikahan kedua ayahnya, ia melarikan diri dalam perjalanan darat epik bersama sahabat-sahabatnya untuk mengukuhkan tempat mereka dalam sejarah pengamatan burung.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' tells the story of ten year-old Austen Kittredge who is sent by his father to live on his grandparents' Vermont farm, where he experiences wild adventures and uncovers long-festering family secrets. It's 1956 and Austen experiences the farm as a place full of eccentric people, especially his stubborn grandparents whose thorny marriage is known as the Forty Years War. Initially feeling stuck in this fractured household, young Austen plans a quick exit but ends up stranded with no choice but to navigate and endure. A humorous and sometimes startling coming-of-age-story, 'Northern Borders' evokes Vermont's wildness, its sublime beauty, a haunted past, and an aura of enchantment.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

programme.title: Leaves Of Grass
programme.desc: An Ivy League professor is lured back to his Oklahoma hometown, where his twin brother, a small-time pot grower, has concocted a scheme to take down a local drug lord.

programme.title: Leaves Of Grass
programme.desc: Seorang profesor Ivy League dibujuk kembali ke kampung halamannya di Oklahoma, tempat saudara kembarnya, seorang petani kecil-kecilan yang telah menyusun skema untuk menjatuhkan raja narkoba setempat.

programme.desc: A rom-com about the adventures of a small town teacher, Kate Carter, going back to the city for her wedding. After a blizzard strikes, she is forced to travel with a stranger named Redford who leaves her questioning her future plans.

programme.title: A Frosty Affair
programme.desc: Sebuah komedi romantis tentang petualangan seorang guru dari kota kecil, Kate Carter, yang kembali ke kota besar untuk pernikahannya. Setelah badai salju melanda, ia terpaksa melakukan perjalanan dengan orang asing bernama Redford yang membuatnya mempertanyakan rencana masa depannya.

programme.title: The Prince & Me 3: Honeymoon
programme.desc: Six months after their royal wedding, King Edvard and Queen Paige escape the pressures of palace life for a honeymoon in the picturesque protectorate of Belavia. Their romantic getaway is soon interrupted when they uncover a scheme led by a corrupt politician to exploit the region for personal gain. Facing betrayal, political intrigue, and unexpected danger, the royal couple must work together to protect Belavia while proving that their love and commitment are stronger than any challenge they encounter.

programme.title: The Prince & Me 3: Honeymoon
programme.desc: Enam bulan setelah pernikahan mereka, Raja Edvard dan Ratu Paige meninggalkan kesibukan kerajaan untuk menikmati bulan madu di wilayah Belavia yang indah. Namun suasana romantis berubah ketika mereka menemukan rencana licik seorang pejabat yang ingin mengeksploitasi wilayah tersebut demi kepentingan pribadi. Di tengah intrik politik, pengkhianatan, dan berbagai tantangan, pasangan kerajaan ini harus bersatu melindungi Belavia sekaligus membuktikan bahwa cinta, kepercayaan, dan kerja sama mampu mengatasi setiap rintangan.

programme.title: Behaving Badly

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens menyukai Nina Pennington. Mereka menjalin persahabatan dan melakukan perjalanan bersama selagi Nina bertengkar dengan pacarnya yang sombong, Kevin.

programme.title: Unnatural
programme.desc: Global climate change prompts a corporation to genetically modify Alaskan polar bears with horrific and deadly results.

programme.title: Unnatural
programme.desc: Perubahan iklim dunia membuat sebuah perusahaan melakukan rekayasa genetik pada sekelompok beruang kutub Alaska yang ternyata memberi dampak nan mengerikan dan mematikan.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu, an ambitious young man who dreams of being a professional hip-hop dancer. When his father issues an ultimatum, Tu decides that dance is his way out.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: An old man suffering from cancer seeks revenge on the thieves who have destroyed his life.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Seorang pria lanjut usia yang menderita kanker, melakukan aksi balas dendam kepada para pencuri yang telah menghancurkan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Bird Catcher
programme.desc: A Jewish girl, Esther, forced to conceal her true identity by pretending to be boy on a Nazi-Norwegian farm, plots her escape.

programme.title: The Bird Catcher
programme.desc: Seorang gadis Yahudi bernama Esther dipaksa untuk menyembunyikan identitas aslinya dengan berpura-pura menjadi anak laki-laki di sebuah peternakan Nazi di Norwegia. Ia pun berencana untuk melarikan diri.

programme.title: After Ever Happy
programme.desc: As a shocking truth about a couple's families emerges, the two lovers discover they are not so different from each other.

programme.title: The Professor And The Madman
programme.desc: The story of Professor James Murray compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century.

programme.title: The Professor And The Madman
programme.desc: Kisah Profesor James Murray menyusun kata-kata untuk Kamus Inggris Oxford edisi pertama pada pertengahan abad ke-19.

programme.title: Frozen Ground
programme.desc: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

programme.title: After We Fell
programme.desc: Just as Tessa makes the biggest decision of her life, everything changes. Revelations about her family, and then Hardin's, throw everything they knew before in doubt and makes their future together more difficult.

programme.title: After We Fell
programme.desc: Segalanya berubah usai Tessa membuat keputusan terbesar dalam hidupnya. Sejumlah fakta yang terungkap tentang keluarganya dan keluarga Hardin, membuat keduanya menjadi ragu dan masa depan mereka menjadi lebih sulit.

programme.title: Condor's Nest
programme.desc: A decade after the fall of Nazi Germany, an American aviator travels across South America in search of war criminals and encounters more than he bargained for.

programme.title: Condor's Nest
programme.desc: Satu dekade setelah jatuhnya Nazi Jerman, seorang pilot Amerika melakukan perjalanan melintasi Amerika Selatan untuk mencari para penjahat perang dan mengalami situasi tak terduga.

programme.title: A Cry From Within
programme.desc: After a devastating miscarriage, a family trades their city lifestyle for a quiet life in the country but soon find themselves at the mercy of a terrifying and violent manifestation.

programme.title: A Cry From Within
programme.desc: Setelah mengalami keguguran, sebuah keluarga meninggalkan kota dan pindah ke pedesaan untuk hidup tenang, tapi kehidupan mereka justru penuh dengan kengerian dan kekerasan.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Call
programme.desc: When a veteran 911 operator takes a life-altering call from a teenage girl who has just been abducted, she realizes that she must confront a killer from her past in order to save the girl's life.

programme.title: The Call
programme.desc: Saat seorang operator 911 veteran menerima panggilan dari seorang gadis remaja yang baru saja diculik, ia menyadari bahwa ia harus menghadapi sang pembunuh dari masa lalunya demi menyelamatkan nyawa gadis itu.

programme.title: The Folks
programme.desc: Mary receives a visit from his brother and mother, whom she had never met previously, following her husband's funeral. Mary finds out that her late husband's relatives are harmful for both herself and her son Tony.

programme.title: The Folks
programme.desc: Setelah pemakaman suaminya, Mary menerima kunjungan dari saudara laki-laki dan ibunya, yang belum pernah ia temui sebelumnya. Mary mengetahui bahwa kerabat mendiang suaminya berbahaya bagi dirinya dan putranya, Tony.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: Four high school students look to redefine themselves after graduation.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang empat murid SMA yang ingin membuka lembaran baru setelah lulus sekolah.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: After being stabbed in the heart by ruthless home invaders, a man is left for dead. Now weak, outnumbered, and knife sticking from his chest, he attempts to do the impossible: save his wife from these murderers before he bleeds to death.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: A team of scientists aboard the International Space Station discover a rapidly evolving life form that caused extinction on Mars and now threatens all life on Earth.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Sebuah tim ilmuwan yang tiba di Stasiun Luar Angkasa Internasional menemukan kehidupan nan berkembang pesat yang menyebabkan kepunahan di Mars dan kini mengancam kehidupan semua makhluk di muka Bumi.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: A Manhattan detective is pit against a young crew that specializes in elaborate heists.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: Seorang detektif di Manhattan harus berhadapan dengan sekelompok pria yang mengkhususkan diri mereka dalam aksi perampokan yang rumit.

programme.title: Meet The Blacks
programme.desc: As Carl Black gets the opportunity to move his family out of Chicago in hope of a better life, their arrival in Beverly Hills is timed with that city's annual purge, where all crime is legal for twelve hours.

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Two aimless middle-aged losers still living at home are forced against their will to become roommates when their parents marry.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: While in his teens, Donny fathered a son, Todd, and raised him as a single parent until Todd's 18th birthday.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Saat remaja, Donny menjadi ayah seorang putra, Todd, dan membesarkannya sebagai orang tua tunggal hingga Todd berusia 18 tahun.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: A malfunction in a sleeping pod on a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet wakes one passenger 90 years early.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Kerusakan pada satu kapsul tidur di sebuah pesawat menuju sebuah planet koloni nan jauh membangunkan seorang penumpang 90 tahun lebih awal.

programme.title: Mission...: Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and his team take on their most impossible mission yet when they have to eradicate an international rogue organization as highly skilled as they are and committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: An eclectic foursome of aspiring teenage witches get more than they bargained for as they lean into their newfound powers.

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Empat remaja perempuan yang bercita-cita menjadi penyihir dengan gaya unik mendapatkan lebih dari yang mereka harapkan saat mereka mulai menggunakan kekuatan baru mereka.

programme.title: Superbad (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

programme.title: Superbad (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Dua siswa SMA harus mengatasi kegelisahan mereka akan perpisahan setelah rencana mereka untuk mengadakan sebuah pesta berakhir berantakan.

programme.title: Collateral (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: A cab driver finds himself the hostage of an engaging contract killer as he makes his rounds from hit to hit during one night in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Collateral (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang sopir taksi mendapati dirinya disandera oleh seorang pembunuh bayaran yang menarik saat ia melakukan tugasnya dari satu target ke target lainnya dalam satu malam di Los Angeles.

programme.title: Tears Of The Sun
programme.desc: A Special-Ops commander leads his team into the Nigerian jungle in order to rescue a doctor who will only join them if they agree to save 70 refugees too.

programme.title: Tears Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang komandan Operasi Khusus memimpin timnya ke hutan Nigeria untuk menyelamatkan seorang dokter yang hanya akan bergabung dengan mereka jika mereka setuju untuk menyelamatkan 70 pengungsi juga.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: A beautiful haemophage infected with a virus that gives her superhuman powers has to protect a boy in a futuristic world, who is thought to be carrying antigens that would destroy all hæmophages.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Gembong narkoba yang dipenjara menawarkan hadiah uang tunai dalam jumlah besar bagi siapa saja yang dapat membebaskannya dari tahanan polisi, dan hanya tim Senjata dan Taktik Khusus L.A.P.D. yang dapat mencegahnya.

programme.title: 30 Days Of Night
programme.desc: After an Alaskan town is plunged into darkness for a month, it is attacked by a bloodthirsty gang of vampires.

programme.title: 30 Days Of Night

programme.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, dan Little Rock pindah ke jantung Amerika saat mereka menghadapi segerombolan zombie yang berevolusi, sesama penyintas, dan kekacauan dalam keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Brad Pitt: Breaking Hollywood

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.desc: After a devastating flood disrupted last season's excavation, Rick and Marty Lagina reunite with the Fellowship of the Dig to continue their decades-long search for Oak Island's legendary treasure. Armed with cutting-edge drilling technology, ground-penetrating surveys, and fresh archaeological evidence, the team investigates newly discovered shafts, underground voids, and intriguing artifacts that could finally lead them to the elusive Money Pit. As each discovery raises new questions, Season 12 brings the Fellowship closer than ever to uncovering one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 25
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 3
programme.desc: The Hand That Robbed the Cradle revisits the remarkable true story of Delimar Vera, who disappeared as an infant after a suspicious house fire in 1997. Through interviews, archival footage, and investigative reporting, the three-part documentary uncovers the twists and turns that led to the discovery that Delimar was alive years later, exposing deception, resilience, and a family's relentless search for the truth.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 3
programme.desc: The Hand That Robbed the Cradle mengulas kembali kisah nyata penculikan Delimar Vera, bayi yang dinyatakan meninggal setelah kebakaran rumah yang mencurigakan pada tahun 1997. Melalui wawancara eksklusif, rekaman arsip, dan penelusuran investigatif, dokumenter tiga episode ini mengungkap bagaimana berbagai kejanggalan akhirnya membawa pada penemuan bahwa Delimar masih hidup bertahun-tahun kemudian. Kisah ini menyoroti perjuangan keluarga mencari kebenaran di balik salah satu kasus penculikan anak yang paling mengejutkan di Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: Project Runway S21: Couture

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Viking Wedding
programme.desc: Woodstone Manor hosts a couple determined to celebrate their love with an elaborate Viking-themed wedding. While Sam and Jay work to ensure the ceremony goes smoothly, the resident ghosts eagerly insert themselves into the festivities, each with their own opinions and hidden agendas. As misunderstandings and supernatural mishaps threaten the big day, the celebration becomes an unforgettable mix of romance, comedy, and paranormal chaos.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Viking Wedding

Beragam kesalahpahaman, aksi kocak, dan gangguan supranatural membuat hari bahagia pasangan pengantin dipenuhi kejutan. programme.title: Matlock S1: Crash Helmets On

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.desc: A cooking show featuring Chef Devina as she shares practical recipes, cooking techniques, and menu ideas for every occasion.

programme.title: Makan Enak
programme.desc: Makan Enak is a program that presents a collection of videos from Indonesian and foreign food vloggers about food menus, places to eat, or about unique and definitely delicious ways to eat food.

programme.title: Laper Mata
programme.desc: Laper Mata takes viewers on a flavorful journey through delicious dishes from various regions. Featuring tempting food visuals and exciting reviews, the show is guaranteed to make everyone hungry.

programme.title: Masak Gesss!!!
programme.desc: MASAK GESSS!!!A simple yet delicious regional culinary adventure.

programme.title: Carita de ángel
programme.desc: The adventures and lessons learned of the daughter of a depressed rich widower, a sweet-hearted and smart little girl who still talks to her deceased mother.

programme.title: Kupu Malam
programme.desc: Laura is a beautiful, smart college student who works as a prostitute. One of her clients becomes obsessed with her but she refuses him due to her principles. She tries to start a new life however the past keeps chasing her.

programme.title: Alaspati: Hutan Mati
programme.desc: For fame, Raya and his friends came to the haunted area. When making video, one of them died. They decided to flee but the ghost is coming with them.

programme.title: Customs Protection
programme.desc: This reality TV show, which follows the daily lives of several customs officers, not only lets viewers witness Indonesia’s Customs and Excise Agency in action during raids, but also takes us behind the scenes to see what actually happens on the ground.
In the 86 program, viewers will be invited to see the daily lives of several police officers.

programme.title: My Happy Ending
programme.desc: A heroine, who spent her poor childhood, trying to escape her desire and obsession after running through life drunk with success.

programme.title: Are You Human?
programme.desc: A young heir falls into a coma after being brutally assaulted. However, his mother is determined to keep him in the race for the family fortune and creates a robot to replace him.

programme.title: Cheat On Me If You Can
programme.desc: A comic mystery thriller about a novelist wife who only thinks about how to kill people and her husband, a divorce lawyer who wrote a memorandum titled "If You Cheat, You Die".

programme.title: Top Spot
programme.desc: This program discusses information from within and outside the country in a light and entertaining manner. It is presented sequentially, according to an interesting and informative theme.

programme.title: AADD: Ada Apa Dengan Dunia
programme.desc: What's happening in the world today? All the events and tragedies currently happening around the world will be summarized clearly and up-to-date. Only on Net TV!

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT’S FAMILY AS THEY BEGIN A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH’S DREAM FOOD STALL, TO THE HILARIOUS UPS AND DOWNS OF LIVING NEXT DOOR TO CEU KOKOM, AND PAK SOMAT’S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI DRIVER FOR HIS FAMILY. A HEARTWARMING STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND MORAL LESSONS FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PETUALANGAN PORORO DAN TEMAN DI DUNIA AJAIB)
programme.desc: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA IS A CHILDREN’S TELEVISION PROGRAM THAT OFFERS EXCITING AND EDUCATIONAL ENTERTAINMENT FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY. FEATURING FUN ANIMATED FILMS AND ENGAGING STORIES, THE PROGRAM PRESENTS HUMOROUS ADVENTURES FILLED WITH VALUABLE MORAL LESSONS THAT EVERYONE CAN ENJOY TOGETHER. IT PROVIDES A SPECIAL OPPORTUNITY FOR INDONESIAN FAMILIES TO COME TOGETHER AND SHARE QUALITY TIME THROUGH MEMORABLE AND ENTERTAINING STORIES.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: Liko and Roy's adventure reaches a whole new level! Joined by their new friend Ult and Roy's Lucario, which can Mega Evolve, they reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Together, the heroes set out to investigate the mystery behind a strange pink mist that is affecting Pokémon across different regions.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Cinta Dari Surga

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda Afrika-Amerika mengunjungi orangtua pacarnya yang berkulit putih untuk akhir pekan, di mana kegelisahannya yang membara tentang penerimaan mereka terhadapnya akhirnya mencapai titik didih.

programme.title: Rambo 3
programme.desc: Rambo yang penyendiri meninggalkan biara Buddha untuk membebaskan mentornya dari Pasukan Khusus (Green Beret) yang berada di bawah kendali Soviet di Afghanistan.

programme.title: Hellboy 2: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Seorang pangeran dari dunia mistis memulai pemberontakan terhadap umat manusia untuk menguasai Bumi. Hellboy dan timnya harus berjuang untuk menghentikannya menemukan Golden Army yang sangat kuat.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dorongan seorang ilmuwan terhadap kecerdasan buatan memiliki implikasi berbahaya ketika kesadarannya sendiri diunggah ke dalam salah satu program tersebut.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
programme.desc: Seorang taipan korup membunuh saksi kejahatan. Hanya pacar seorang pengusaha yang memiliki hubungan dengan pemerintah Tiongkok yang melihat kejadian tersebut. Pengawal dari Beijing membantu polisi Hong Kong melindunginya. Namun, ia dan saksi tersebut mulai memiliki perasaan, yang memperumit keadaan.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: Mata-mata Inggris, George Trent, menghilang di Ibiza. Appleton Porter dikirim untuk menyelidiki, menanyai para tamu hotel yang merupakan tetangga Trent. Trent selamat dari upaya pembunuhan sambil mengungkap misteri tersebut.

programme.title: Godzilla Minus One (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Seorang pilot kamikaze yang dihantui rasa bersalah karena selamat mencari penebusan ketika monster raksasa yang gagal ia bunuh berubah bentuk akibat radiasi dari uji coba bom atom dan mengepung Jepang pasca-perang.

programme.title: Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Pt 1 (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen berada di Distrik 13 setelah ia menghancurkan dunia game selamanya. Di bawah kepemimpinan Presiden Coin dan nasihat dari teman-teman kepercayaannya, Katniss mengembangkan sayapnya saat ia berjuang menyelamatkan Peeta dan bangsa yang tergerak oleh keberaniannya.

programme.title: Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Pt 2 (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Katniss dan tim pemberontak dari Distrik 13 bersiap untuk pertempuran terakhir yang akan menentukan nasib Panem.

programme.title: Fist From Shaolin
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hong (Wong Kwan) harus melawan pedagang budak Master Eleven (Ji Chun Hua) dan Prefek Wu untuk menghentikan penjualan orang Tionghoa sebagai budak untuk bekerja di tambang emas di Amerika.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen dan Peeta Mellark menjadi target Capitol setelah kemenangan mereka dalam Hunger Games ke-74 memicu pemberontakan di Distrik Panem.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys

programme.title: 3:10 To Yuma

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. programme.title: Halo Selebriti
programme.desc: Acara ini menampilkan kabar seputar kehidupan selebriti, mulai dari aktivitas, prestasi, hingga gosip terkini yang sedang menjadi sorotan publik.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Pro On Their Speciality
programme.desc: Pro On Their Speciality merupakan program magazine gaya hidup yang menampilkan kisah inspiratif dari berbagai penjuru Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi tokoh-tokoh dengan keahlian khusus, seperti pengrajin, petani, pelaku UMKM, hingga pakar kuliner yang sukses mengembangkan bidangnya. Selain mengangkat perjalanan dan dedikasi mereka, acara ini juga memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya, tradisi, makanan khas, serta destinasi menarik yang mencerminkan keberagaman Taiwan. Dengan perpaduan informasi, perjalanan, dan kisah inspiratif, program ini memberikan wawasan sekaligus hiburan bagi pemirsa.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Combining fantasy, humor, and adventure, the series offers an imaginative experience for young audiences.

programme.title: LA NUIT DES ROIS
programme.desc: Set inside La MACA, a prison deep within the Ivorian forest where prisoners govern themselves according to their own rules, La Nuit des Rois follows a newly arrived inmate who is selected to become the prison's “Roman,” a storyteller tasked with entertaining fellow prisoners during the night of a red moon. As he recounts the mythical story of the feared outlaw Zama King, the boundaries between reality, folklore, performance, and survival begin to blur. Blending prison drama with African oral storytelling traditions and magical realism, the film explores power, identity, and the life-saving force of imagination.

programme.title: LA NUIT DES ROIS
programme.desc: Berlatar di La MACA, sebuah penjara yang terletak di tengah hutan Pantai Gading dan memiliki aturan unik yang dijalankan oleh para narapidana sendiri, La Nuit des Rois mengisahkan seorang tahanan muda yang baru tiba dan ditunjuk sebagai “Roman”, pendongeng yang harus menghibur para penghuni penjara sepanjang malam saat bulan merah terbit. Menyadari bahwa nasibnya bergantung pada kemampuannya mempertahankan cerita hingga fajar, ia mulai menuturkan kisah legendaris tentang Zama King, seorang tokoh kriminal yang hampir menyerupai mitos. Seiring berjalannya malam, cerita yang ia sampaikan berkembang menjadi perpaduan antara kenyataan, legenda, fantasi, dan sejarah, menghadirkan pengalaman sinematik yang unik tentang kekuasaan, tradisi lisan Afrika, serta kekuatan cerita sebagai alat bertahan hidup.

programme.title: LA PROHIBITION AMÉRICAINE, UNE AUBAINE FRANÇAISE
programme.desc: La Prohibition Américaine, Une Aubaine Française explores the hidden French side of the American Prohibition era. As the Volstead Act outlawed alcohol in the United States, demand for liquor remained high, creating lucrative opportunities for smugglers and criminal networks. The French archipelago of Saint-Pierre and Miquelon, located just off the North American coast, became a strategic transit point for champagne, wine, cognac, and other French products destined for American consumers. Through archival footage, historical accounts, and expert analysis, the documentary examines how French authorities, merchants, and shipping companies benefited from this unexpected economic windfall while American officials struggled to stop the thriving underground trade.

programme.title: LA PROHIBITION AMÉRICAINE, UNE AUBAINE FRANÇAISE
programme.desc: La Prohibition Américaine, Une Aubaine Française mengangkat sisi lain dari era Prohibition di Amerika Serikat. Ketika Volstead Act melarang masyarakat Amerika memproduksi, menjual, dan mengimpor minuman beralkohol, permintaan terhadap alkohol tetap tinggi dan memicu berkembangnya jaringan penyelundupan berskala besar. Kepulauan Saint-Pierre dan Miquelon yang berada di bawah kekuasaan Prancis menjadi titik transit utama bagi sampanye, anggur, cognac, dan berbagai produk alkohol Prancis yang diselundupkan ke Amerika. Melalui arsip sejarah, kesaksian para ahli, dan rekonstruksi peristiwa, film ini memperlihatkan bagaimana perdagangan tersebut membantu menggerakkan ekonomi Prancis yang sedang berjuang pasca-Perang Dunia I, sekaligus menunjukkan hubungan erat antara politik, bisnis, dan kejahatan terorganisasi selama salah satu periode paling terkenal dalam sejarah Amerika.

programme.title: L'AMOUR À LA MER
programme.desc: Set between Brest and Paris, the film follows Geneviève, a young woman who falls in love with a sailor during her vacation by the sea. As autumn arrives, the couple must separate and return to their respective lives. Through letters, memories, and longing, they attempt to preserve their relationship despite the distance between them. Blending romance with reflections on youth, freedom, and post-war France, the film paints a poetic portrait of love challenged by time and separation.

programme.title: L'AMOUR À LA MER
programme.desc: Berlatar antara Brest dan Paris, film ini mengisahkan Geneviève yang jatuh cinta kepada seorang pelaut saat menghabiskan liburan musim panas di tepi laut. Namun, berakhirnya musim panas memaksa keduanya kembali ke kehidupan masing-masing. Terpisah oleh jarak, mereka tetap saling berhubungan melalui surat-surat yang penuh kerinduan dan harapan untuk bertemu kembali. Dengan nuansa puitis dan melankolis, film ini mengeksplorasi cinta, kebebasan, serta pencarian jati diri di tengah perubahan hidup.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 2
programme.desc: The cast visits another seaside destination where they immerse themselves in the daily routines of the local community. From gathering seasonal seafood and fresh produce to cooking hearty dishes together, they experience the rewards and challenges of coastal living. Along the way, their teamwork, humor, and genuine interactions create heartwarming and entertaining moments that celebrate nature, food, and friendship.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 2
programme.desc: Para anggota mengunjungi destinasi pesisir baru untuk merasakan kehidupan masyarakat setempat. Mereka mengumpulkan hasil laut dan bahan pangan musiman, kemudian mengolahnya menjadi hidangan lezat sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan sehari-hari. Kerja sama, canda, dan kebersamaan di tengah suasana alam yang indah menghadirkan pengalaman yang hangat sekaligus menghibur.

programme.title: Walking Through Village, Ep 10
programme.desc: Actor Gu Bon-seung shows the warmth and purity of life in the village along the river, and presents how new history was made and became one's memory.

programme.title: Walking Through Village, Ep 10
programme.desc: Aktor Gu Bon-seung akan menunjukkan kehangatan dan kesederhanaan tinggal di desa pinggir sungai, serta bagaimana sejarah baru dibuat dan menjadi kenangan bagi seseorang.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake, Ep 1
programme.desc: The cast members take on a new set of space-themed missions designed to challenge their creativity, cooperation, and adaptability. As they work together to overcome unexpected obstacles, friendly competition and lighthearted moments create plenty of laughs. Their performances determine who gains advantages while bringing viewers another entertaining chapter of the imaginative variety series.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake, Ep 1
programme.desc: Para peserta kembali menjalani serangkaian misi bertema luar angkasa yang menguji kreativitas, kekompakan, dan kemampuan mereka beradaptasi dengan berbagai situasi tak terduga. Di tengah persaingan yang semakin seru, mereka harus bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan setiap tantangan sambil menghadirkan berbagai aksi lucu dan spontan. Hasil setiap misi menjadi penentu keunggulan peserta sekaligus memberikan hiburan yang segar bagi penonton.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 8
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier follows Kang Seong-jae, a young man from a humble background who joins the army after losing his father. Although he excels during training, he is assigned to work in the military kitchen due to his experience helping at his father's food truck. One day, a mysterious virtual interface appears before him and begins assigning cooking-related missions. As he completes each challenge, his culinary skills improve dramatically, earning the respect of fellow soldiers and superiors alike. Alongside the humor and camaraderie of military life, Seong-jae gradually uncovers hidden secrets connected to his father's death. Blending military comedy, fantasy, and food-themed storytelling, the series delivers an uplifting tale of perseverance, friendship, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 8
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 7
programme.desc: Mr. Eo and his team set out into the unknown for new recipes, cooking up one-of-a-kind dishes along the way.

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 7
programme.desc: Mr. Eo dan timnya menjelajah ke tempat-tempat yang belum dikenal untuk mencari resep baru, sambil menciptakan hidangan-hidangan yang unik sepanjang perjalanan.

programme.title: Sixth Sense: City Tour, Ep 5
programme.desc: Sixth Sense is back with a 'City Tour'! A special trip to find hot places and trendy issues that have taken over SNS has hidden a single fake! The legendary 4-person talkative group of Yoo Jae Suk X Song Eun Yi X Go Kyung Pyo X Mimi embarks on a trip to find fakes in the city!

programme.title: Kill It: Style Creator..., Ep 9

Program ini mencari individu yang mampu memimpin tren fesyen terkini, berkomunikasi dengan masyarakat luas, serta menciptakan budaya dan pengaruh baru di dunia fesyen.

One day, a mysterious virtual interface appears before him and begins assigning cooking-related missions. As he completes each challenge, his culinary skills improve dramatically, earning the respect of fellow soldiers and superiors alike. Alongside the humor and camaraderie of military life, Seong-jae gradually uncovers hidden secrets connected to his father's death. Blending military comedy, fantasy, and food-themed storytelling, the series delivers an uplifting tale of perseverance, friendship, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 8
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.
